About Word of the Day — how to play & tips

How to play

Meet a new word every day: guess its meaning from four options, then see the full definition, examples, synonyms and origin. Keep a daily streak going, or switch to Practice for an endless vocabulary quiz.

Tips

Read the example sentences — context locks a word in better than the definition alone. Practice mode resurfaces the words you miss so they stick.
